item.title: github: Changes to query results in the GitHub Actions API and UI
item.description:
GitHub Actions workflow run queries in the API and UI now return a less precise but more accurate total count for search results across filters like workflow, event, status, and branch.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Refreshed repository pull requests page generally available
item.description:
GitHub has generally available a refreshed repository pull requests page for all users. The update is intended to make pull requests easier to find and act on from one place.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: commandline: Designing product simplicity for the AI era
item.description:
The article asks whether shared design components are sufficient for a seamless product experience, or whether designers need to prioritize simplicity over complexity to create consistency. It frames this as a product design question for the AI era.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: github: AI credit pools for cost centers in the billing UI
item.description:
GitHub Billing UI now lets you manage a cost center’s AI credit pool directly when creating or editing cost centers. Before this change, that configuration was only available through another interface.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Releases: Sidebar navigation and per-asset download counts
item.description:
GitHub Releases now include a dedicated sidebar table of contents for easier navigation, and release metadata has been rearranged for a more consistent layout. Per-asset download counts are also shown on release pages.

  • Source: GitHub
